curriculum.subject: Mathematical Activities
curriculum.outcomeText: use money to buy up to 2 items without balance

mission.title: use money to buy up to 2 items without balance

interactions.prompt: A banana costs sh.5. Which coin pays for it exactly?
interactions.feedback: Yes! A sh.5 coin pays for a sh.5 banana. There is no balance.
interactions.retryHint: Look for the coin with the same number as the price: 5.

interactions.prompt: Milk costs sh.10. Put the sh.10 coin in the pay tray.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap the sh.10 coin, then tap the pay tray.
interactions.feedback: Great! sh.10 pays exactly for milk. No money comes back.
interactions.retryHint: The price says 10. Choose the coin that says 10.

interactions.prompt: Bread costs sh.10. Choose coins that make sh.10 exactly.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap two sh.5 coins, or tap one sh.10 coin. Then tap Check.
interactions.feedback: Well done! sh.5 and sh.5 make sh.10, so there is no balance.
interactions.retryHint: Count 5, then one more 5: that makes 10.

interactions.prompt: A mango costs sh.20. Which payment has no balance?
interactions.feedback: Correct! sh.20 is the same as the mango price, so there is no balance.
interactions.retryHint: Find the payment with the same amount as the price, 20.

interactions.prompt: At the classroom shop, buy a sh.5 pencil and a sh.10 eraser. Pay sh.15 exactly.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap the sh.5 coin and the sh.10 coin, then tap Check.
interactions.feedback: Excellent! sh.5 plus sh.10 is sh.15. You bought two items with no balance.
interactions.retryHint: Pay for the pencil first: 5. Add the eraser: 10. 5 and 10 make 15.

interactions.prompt: Show what you know. Buy a sh.20 ball and a sh.20 book. Choose money that pays sh.40 exactly.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap the sh.40 coin, then tap Check.
interactions.feedback: Well done! sh.40 pays for both items exactly. There is no balance.
interactions.retryHint: The two prices are 20 and 20. Put them together to make 40.
